# HelloAgenticAI — Agent Observability

Live operational dashboard for the fruit-market agent runs.

Data source: the `dependencies` table, populated by `AppInsightsSink` (Phase 4 batch 4). Each `AgentEvent` becomes a short-lived OpenTelemetry span whose `name` is the event type (`plan_start`, `tool_call`, `schema_validation_failed`, `guardrail_blocked`, etc.). The span's `customDimensions` carry `session_id`, `node`, `duration_ms`, and the flattened payload under `payload.*` keys.

The span's own duration is a near-zero with-block scope; **always read the real duration from `customDimensions.duration_ms`** (toint() coercion needed).

**Why `dependencies` (not `requests`):** `tracer.start_as_current_span(name)` creates spans with `SpanKind.INTERNAL` by default, and the `azure-monitor-opentelemetry` exporter maps INTERNAL spans to App Insights' `dependencies` table (= `AppDependencies` in the Log Analytics workspace schema). `requests` (= `AppRequests`) only receives `SpanKind.SERVER` spans. See ADR-0003 risk #9 for the discovery story.

content.title: Agent runs (last 24h)
content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == "complete"
| summarize Count = count()

content.title: Events per minute by type
content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name in ("plan_start", "plan_complete", "tool_call", "tool_result", "reflect", "complete", "schema_validation_failed", "guardrail_blocked")
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1m), name
| render timechart

content.title: Plan-to-complete latency (p50 / p95, 5-min buckets)
content.query:
let runs =
    dependencies
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | where name in ("plan_start", "complete")
    | extend session_id = tostring(customDimensions.session_id)
    | summarize start_t = minif(timestamp, name == "plan_start"),
                end_t   = minif(timestamp, name == "complete")
              by session_id
    | where isnotnull(start_t) and isnotnull(end_t)
    | extend duration_ms = todouble(end_t - start_t) / 1ms;
runs
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration_ms, 50),
            p95 = percentile(duration_ms, 95)
          by bin(end_t, 5m)
| render timechart

content.title: Top 5 schema-validation failures by Pydantic model
content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == "schema_validation_failed"
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions["payload.model"])
| extend node = tostring(customDimensions.node)
| summarize failures = count() by model, node
| top 5 by failures desc

content.title: Top 5 Content Safety blocks by gate + categories
content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == "guardrail_blocked"
| extend gate = tostring(customDimensions["payload.gate"])
| extend categories = tostring(customDimensions["payload.categories"])
| extend severity_name = tostring(customDimensions["payload.severity_name"])
| summarize blocks = count() by gate, categories, severity_name
| top 5 by blocks desc

## Cost trend — deferred to framework-v2

The cost-trend chart was scoped in the Phase 4 kickoff but required surfacing `response.usage` from `AzureOpenAIClient.chat_structured` AND threading it into the AgentEvent payload via an AgentBase hook + 3 emit-site updates + tests + workbook KQL. Estimated at >30 min (the kickoff's defer threshold), so it landed on the framework-v2 mental shelf instead.

Follow-on work: see `docs/framework-v2-backlog.md`. When that ships, a `dependencies | where name == "plan_complete" or name == "reflect" | extend tokens = toint(customDimensions["payload.usage.total_tokens"]) | summarize sum_tokens = sum(tokens) by bin(timestamp, 1h)` query slots in here.
